meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能把你的历史操作记录整理成专题知识库：先按项目、概念等条件筛选内容，再加载成可对话的会话，之后你提问它就从中回答。还能重建、刷新知识库。
howto.when: 当你要求基于过往观察记录建立某个专题的“大脑”，或想询问过去的工作方式、整理特定主题的经验时触发。

say.text: 用我关于 hooks 的记录建一个叫 hooks-expertise 的知识库。
say.note: 会执行构建语料库操作。

say.text: 把 hooks-expertise 知识库加载起来。
say.note: 会初始化承载知识的 AI 会话。

say.text: 在这个知识库里，5 个生命周期钩子分别何时触发？
say.note: 会从该语料库中检索并回答。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude turn your past observation records into topic-specific knowledge bases: it filters relevant content by project, concept, etc., loads it into a conversational AI session, then answers questions from it. It can also rebuild and refresh corpora.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to create a focused 'brain' from past observations, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a specific topic.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge base named hooks-expertise from my records about hooks.

say_en.note: Initializes the AI session with that corpus.

say_en.text: In this knowledge base, when do the 5 lifecycle hooks fire?
say_en.note: Queries the corpus for an answer.
